description.value:
You seize a target with a biotic field, lift them helplessly into the air, then slam them into the ground with crushing force.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-slam] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and is moved 5 feet in any direction.

Failure The target is lifted 10 feet into the air and then slammed down, taking @Damage[(3*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and becoming Stunned 1 and Prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(6*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage, Stunned 2, and the target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
